summary.headline: Nara Space Technology wins KRW 10.1bn satellite development contract with K-water, 76.39% of recent revenue
summary.what_happened: Nara Space Technology signed a single supply contract on Nov 25, 2026 with Korea Water Resources Corporation (K-water) to develop the K-waterSAT small constellation satellite for water resources. The contract runs from Nov 25, 2026 to Mar 8, 2030, with a contract amount of KRW 10.12bn excluding VAT, and the company will produce it in-house.
summary.why_it_matters: Large supply contracts disclosed under Korean exchange rules generally indicate a significant order relative to a company's revenue, and they typically set out the expected revenue schedule and payment terms, which can affect future reported sales. Contract amounts and periods may change as projects progress.
